sentences.en: I take it that you are fully acquainted with the facts.
sentences.zh: 我想你应该已经对这些事实非常熟悉了。

sentences.en: I soon got acquainted with almost all about my new job.
sentences.zh: 我很快就熟悉了新工作中的几乎所有事情。

sentences.en: I am acquainted with the chairman of that club.
sentences.zh: 我对那个俱乐部主席有所了解。

senses.zh: 使熟悉,使认识,把某事通知某人，告知
